high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a webpage from the website "universal-sci.com," which discusses the concept of consciousness and its relation to physical systems being highly integrated. The text on the page explains that for consciousness to emerge, the physical system must be highly integrated. It further elaborates that whatever information one is conscious of is presented as a whole and cannot be segregated into separate parts, such as frames of a film or static images. Additionally, it mentions that one cannot completely isolate the information received from each sense.
